children: Adamas Trust reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $194.5M, down 0.9% from the prior-year quarter, and a $171M net loss attributable to common stockholders, compared with net income of $32.7M a year earlier. Diluted loss per share was $(1.89), versus earnings per share of $0.36.
Revenue was $194.5M, compared with $196.3M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (0.9%).
Net loss attributable to common stockholders was $171.0M, compared with net income of $32.7M in the prior-year quarter.
Diluted EPS was $(1.89), compared with $0.36 in the prior-year quarter.
Adamas acquired $1.2B of Agency investments and approximately $394.5M of residential loans, including $390.1M in business-purpose loans.
Its Constructive platform funded $376.5M of business-purpose loans, and management said it intends to continue scaling the platform.
Late in the quarter, the company added TBA short positions to reduce Agency exposure amid rising rates. It reduced those positions by approximately $2.6B after quarter-end.
The company completed a rental-loan securitization and a non-Agency RMBS re-securitization to support portfolio financing.
Management expects market volatility to persist and plans disciplined portfolio growth and prudent capital allocation focused on recurring income.
